name: kb-multimodal-contract-retraction
title: Retract retired KB audio/video model fields from live contracts
description: 审计发现知识库音频/视频模型字段虽然在运行时已 fail-closed，但前后端 live contract 与投影仍继续公开这些字段，需要按新 SaaS 规则收回到非公开拒绝路径。
creator: codex
notes: 2026-04-22 completed: request schemas now hide retired KB audio/video model overrides from public schema surfaces via `SkipJsonSchema` while preserving explicit fail-closed validation, and tenant/admin KB read payloads plus frontend API typings no longer expose `audio_model_id`/`video_model_id` or their derived name fields.
